decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The commercial uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times (8am-11pm Mon-Sat, 9am-10.30pm Sun) and customers to have left the premises within 30 minutes of closing.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No work or associated activities including deliveries /loading /unloading /servicing /or parking or manoeuvring of vehicles by staff and/or visitors shall be carried out on the premises on any Sunday or Bank Holiday nor before 8am or after 6pm on Monday - Friday nor before 8am or after 1pm on Saturdays.

Condition : 6 - Development shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the restaurant of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Change of use at ground floor from A2 (Bank) to A3 (Restaurant)
